teaser: Each row of an agent behaviour policy gets a vendor's share, carried when the vendor's conditions held; contracts cap at a year's fees, Europe moves the line.
core_idea: Every row of an agent's behaviour policy has two parties, the vendor whose product decides some outcomes and the customer who granted access and connected data, so as cloud providers split security of and in the cloud, each row should carry a vendor's share paid when the vendor's conditions held; today's published terms cap vendors at a year's fees and leave outputs to the customer, Microsoft's guardrail-conditional cover shows the shape, and Europe's product liability directive treats software as a product from 9 December 2026.
